market_summary: Benchmark Movements & Technical Levels: Comprehensive technical review of the NASDAQ Composite, S&P 500, Dow Jones Industrial Average, Russell 2000, and RSP (Equal-Weight S&P 500) relative to key moving averages (21-day EMA, 50-day SMA, 200-day SMA, and 10-week lines). Evaluation of the IBD Power Trend status and Follow-Through Day (FTD) signals.
